level_0_global.summary: The water distribution network comprises 383 junction nodes organized into 15 hydraulically coherent partitions via pressure-weighted Leiden community detection. The knowledge base contains 540 pre-simulated leak scenarios spanning leak rates from 2 to 50 L/s across 3 demand periods (night low, day normal, evening peak). Each scenario is encoded as both a natural-language hydraulic summary and a 30-dimensional sensor-differential fingerprint vector.

0.summary: Partition 0 contains 49 junction nodes. This community has been characterized through 36 leak simulation scenarios with leak rates ranging from 2 to 50 L/s. The hydraulic response shows maximum pressure drops between 0.15 and 14.50 meters, affecting 0 to 378 nodes. Demand periods covered: day_normal, evening_peak, night_low. Representative leak nodes in this community: 258, 266. Severity distribution: micro: 6, moderate: 6, moderate-severe: 6, severe: 6, small: 6, small-moderate: 6.
